# TwoTimescaleNeuroEvolution

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuroevolution method that updates network weights and plasticity rules on separate, provably sub-linear timescales to balance exploration and adaptation. Enables scalable online learning in neuromorphic/TCC systems where rapid plasticity must coexist with stable topology evolution.
